comments.body:
Quest name: The Settlement Site in Greenland (Chrono Quest - 3rd period, 18th Century)
Quest location: St. Petersburg Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r8 Recognition, r10 Archaeology, ARC(Far North Languages)
Pre-requisite discovery: Greenland discovery (from "Looking for World's End" quest)
Additional note: "Branch-off" part of Vinland questchain
